cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.description:
Published `react-devtools-inline@4.11.0` has the following piece of code in `react-devtools-inline/dist/backend.js`:

```js
module.exports = require("/Users/bvaughn/Documents/git/react.devtools/packages/react-devtools-shared/src/config/DevToolsFeatureFlags.default");
```
:roll_eyes:

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fixed broken feature flag import for DT inline package
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fixed broken feature flag import for DT inline package

Resolves #21235

I accidentally put the module map in an `externals` map rather than a `resolve.alias` map. Oops.
